project_type: Full-stack TypeScript portal (Vite React SPA + Express API + Supabase)
build_system: Vite (frontend) + esbuild (server.ts bundling) via npm scripts
test_framework: No test framework configured - validation via lint + build
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && npm run lint' (tsc --noEmit). 2. Run 'source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && npm run build' (vite build + esbuild server.ts)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No test framework exists. Supabase CLI not installed - use REST API for migrations. Must source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh before any npm/node commands.
contribution_requirements: Push to feat/emerald-email-otp branch. PR #1 already exists.
key_patterns: Express routes in server/ (auth.ts, data.ts, agents.ts, whatsapp-bot.ts). React components in src/components/. Single AppContext for state. Tailwind 4 + Auralis monochrome design. lucide-react for icons. motion/react for animations. Bilingual support with t(en, mr) helper pattern.
directory_structure: src/components/ - React UI components. src/contexts/ - AppContext. server/ - Express API routes. supabase/migrations/ - SQL migration files. api/ - Vercel serverless entry.
